note: Single source of truth for timing, text, stats, camera and sound. docs/cat-kingdom/beat-sheet.md is generated from this file. Captions use **bold** for the key number and \n for the line break. Every real-world number is sourced in docs/cat-kingdom/sources.md.
intro: The story is fictional; every real-world number is sourced (codes point to `docs/cat-kingdom/sources.md`). The “Day 1 · fictional … Year 5” chip is the invented timeline of the reign. The whole video happens on one tabletop California: miniature cities and cut-away buildings stand at their real locations, and the camera flies between them over the map (no teleporting). Only the final kitchen is a cut.
resets: Office interior (1–2) · flat statewide map (3) · close-up door (4) · fly to San Francisco (5) · Los Angeles (6) · a lab interior (7) · the Central Valley (8) · back to Sacramento (9) · Orange County from above (10) · colour shift to green sanctuaries (11) · Palm Springs (12) · jump in scale to the whole state (13) · cut to one kitchen at evening (14).
